label: lem:strongly_measurable_interior
title: Strong measurability at interior points
statement: If $f$ is continuous on $[\min(a,b), \max(a,b)]$ and $x \in (\min(a,b), \max(a,b))$, then $f$ is strongly measurable at $\texttt{nhds}\; x$. This follows from \texttt{ContinuousOn.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter} via \texttt{isOpen\_Ioo}.
proof: Since $x$ lies in the open set $(\min(a,b), \max(a,b))$, the neighborhood filter at $x$ is contained in the principal filter of the closed interval. Apply \texttt{ContinuousOn.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter}.
